name: Bounded preservation-safe Word text correction
description: Plain body text corrections preserve every unrelated XML byte and package part.

elements.name: A plain run correction preserves opaque markup and media

steps.name: a Word package containing a plain body text run and opaque content
I replace the unique text "old text" with "new & text" through a guarded target
save the edited Word package
only the matched XML character data differs
every other package member retains its payload bytes
reusing the consumed target returns a stale-target refusal

name: Retained-source delivery receipts
description: Receipts describe observed payload changes and failed delivery preserves prior output.

elements.name: A saved receipt agrees with independent package hashes

steps.name: a staged main-part edit with an opaque custom part
I save a main-part replacement with a delivery receipt
the receipt identifies exactly the changed member and both hashes
the delivered archive reopens with unchanged opaque bytes

elements.name: A directory destination refuses without consuming staged changes

steps.name: a staged main-part edit with an opaque custom part
I deliver staged changes to a directory destination
delivery fails without changing the directory
the staged change remains available for another save

name: Retained-source package editing
description: A bounded part replacement preserves every other source payload.

elements.name: A no-op save preserves the exact source archive

steps.name: an Office source archive with an opaque custom part
I open a retained-source editing session and save without edits
the output archive is byte-identical to the source

elements.name: Replacing one part leaves all other member payloads unchanged

steps.name: an Office source archive with an opaque custom part
I replace the main XML part using its current fingerprint
only that member payload changes after saving
the retained source bytes remain unchanged

elements.name: A stale replacement batch leaves all parts unchanged

steps.name: an Office source archive with an opaque custom part
I request two replacements with one stale fingerprint
the batch returns a stale-target refusal
the session still saves the exact original archive
